messages.author: 83e2090afe71ba2a
messages.subject: error message in plot.pls
parts:
Hello there
using the plot.pls function, I got a weird error message:
Error in if (vecnum > plsobj$lim) stop(paste("Rmorph(plot.pls): vecnum value",  : argument is of length zero
I tried running the two.b.pls example with the plethodons and I get the same error when ploting the pls?
Any hint on what is going on?
Best
Vincent
